sectors.name: Schools
sectors.summary: Primary and secondary education. More spending lowers the number of pupils per teacher.

FRA.source: share: Eurostat gov_10a_exp 2024 (universities) and educ_uoe_fine01 2023 (vocational, derived). quantity: Eurostat educ_uoe_perp04, primary, 2024 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/educ_uoe_perp04/default/table)

DEU.source: share: Eurostat gov_10a_exp 2024 (universities) and educ_uoe_fine01 2023 (vocational, derived). quantity: Eurostat educ_uoe_perp04, primary, 2024 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/educ_uoe_perp04/default/table)

POL.source: share: Eurostat gov_10a_exp 2024 (universities) and educ_uoe_fine01 2023 (vocational, derived). quantity: Eurostat educ_uoe_perp04, primary, 2024 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/educ_uoe_perp04/default/table)

GBR.source: share: HM Treasury PESA 2026 table 5.2, 2024-25 outturn, public sector basis (https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a5772f59e63154454413701/PESA_2026_CP_Chapter_5_tables.xlsx); vocational is the default (mean of FRA, DEU, POL). quantity: OECD students per teaching staff, primary, 2024 (https://sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest/data/OECD.EDU.IMEP,DSD_EAG_UOE_NON_FIN_PERS@DF_UOE_NF_PERS_STR,1.1/all)
GBR.note: OECD definition (all teaching staff), not the Eurostat series used for the other nations. Lower secondary 17.0 (2024), upper secondary 18.4 (2021, all institutions).

default.source: share: default: the mean of FRA, DEU, POL and GBR. quantity: default: the mean of FRA, DEU, POL and GBR
default.note: Mean of the four sourced nations (share and quantity).

sectors.name: Universities
sectors.summary: Tertiary education. More spending raises the number of graduates a year for every 1 000 inhabitants.

FRA.source: share: Eurostat gov_10a_exp 2024 (universities) and educ_uoe_fine01 2023 (vocational, derived). quantity: Eurostat educ_uoe_grad01, ISCED 5-8, 2024 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/educ_uoe_grad01/default/table), over Eurostat demo_pjan population

DEU.source: share: Eurostat gov_10a_exp 2024 (universities) and educ_uoe_fine01 2023 (vocational, derived). quantity: Eurostat educ_uoe_grad01, ISCED 5-8, 2024 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/educ_uoe_grad01/default/table), over Eurostat demo_pjan population

POL.source: share: Eurostat gov_10a_exp 2024 (universities) and educ_uoe_fine01 2023 (vocational, derived). quantity: Eurostat educ_uoe_grad01, ISCED 5-8, 2024 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/educ_uoe_grad01/default/table), over Eurostat demo_pjan population

GBR.source: share: HM Treasury PESA 2026 table 5.2, 2024-25 outturn, public sector basis (https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a5772f59e63154454413701/PESA_2026_CP_Chapter_5_tables.xlsx); vocational is the default (mean of FRA, DEU, POL). quantity: Eurostat educ_uoe_grad02, ISCED 5-8, 2019, the last UK year (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/educ_uoe_grad02/default/table), over Eurostat demo_pjan population
GBR.note: 866 745 graduates over 66 647 112 inhabitants (1 January 2019). The share is the true public share: tuition fees run through student loans, outside the PESA table.

default.source: share: default: the mean of FRA, DEU, POL and GBR. quantity: default: the mean of FRA, DEU, POL and GBR
default.note: Mean of the four sourced nations (share and quantity).
